prose: Snigdha Poonam investigates the literary scam economy after receiving an email addressed to 'Professor Snigdha Poonam' from a Seattle life-drawing community eager to discuss her seven-year-old book about young Indians, and to charge her a 'contribution fee' for the privilege. The red flags multiply: the follow-up came from a different organizer at a different community in a different city using the first man's email address, complete with a leftover AI prompt reading 'MAKE IT MORE PROFESSIONAL'. Genuine book clubs do not charge authors; the piece sets out to find who is behind the operation and how it works.
highlights: Author investigates a book-club scam targeting writers
Pitch: fake community invites author, then requests a 'contribution fee'
Tells: wrong title ('Professor'), mismatched organizers and cities, shared email addresses
A leftover AI prompt ('MAKE IT MORE PROFESSIONAL') in the scam email
Genuine book clubs don't charge authors
